mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (particularly hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia); foscarnet's nephrotoxic potential is enhanced when combined with other renally toxic agents like meprobamate.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and urinalysis regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative anxiolytic if possible; adjust dosing based on renal function.
